Great stuff.   Thanks for listening to it!


Francisco Gonzalez (@fgonzalez1978)

There's something I've come to believe deeply: the best education happens when books and travel collide.

Before heading to Medora, North Dakota for a behind-the-scenes tour of the forthcoming @TRPresLibrary, I started listening to @BretBaier's biography, "To Rescue the American Spirit: Teddy Roosevelt and the Birth of a Superpower."

I listened to about half before landing. Picked back up driving through the Badla

Never


Tim Baier (@TimBaier)

I used to own him when we were kids. I’ll see if he admits
It. @BretBaier ??



— https://nitter.net/TimBaier/status/2055440783881163021#m

Was this one?     nitter.net/satireorcry1/status/20…


Cdiehl (@DiehlCL)

I watched your entire show, often do!

But while in China you did about 5 or so segments that were just too much. 

Could easily be mistaken for China Central Television!

Wouldn’t be surprised if they included your segments in the coming days!

Just like Iran Including segments showing Tucker Carlson’s newfound fascination with the IRGC/Mullahs!



— https://nitter.net/DiehlCL/status/2055180884655907083#m

Sorry you missed the shows.   And the other clips.  Thanks.


Cdiehl (@DiehlCL)

Respectfully Bret, this is too much!

You’ve done multiple segments which could easily be mistaken for CCP State TV propaganda!

It’s cringeworthy and tough to watch these unnecessary segments while in China.

How about some normal reporting and a little less CCP propaganda adjacent content?

Do better @BretBaier



— https://nitter.net/DiehlCL/status/2055145909848047858#m

Heading home. But thanks.


Mait (@maityman)

@BretBaier dude I’m in Beijing do you want to chill



— https://nitter.net/maityman/status/2055132495788888498#m
Former LAPD detective Mark Fuhrman, who discovered key evidence in the O.J. Simpson case, has passed away at 74.
Law enforcement urgently investigated potential group ties after two teen suspects allegedly coordinated a fatal shooting at a San Diego mosque. #breakingnews #news #breakingtonight

I sat down with @President Donald J Trump on @Fox News  tonight and he discusses why he’s maintaining a 100% tariff on Chinese cars, a massive new Boeing deal, and the future of manufacturing on U.S. soil.
As I prepare for my interview with @President Donald J Trump tomorrow, I’m reflecting on our past conversations. Tune in tomorrow at 6 PM ET on @Fox News to watch it! #interview #trump #news #foxnews
When you’re on the move in Beijing, one thing is impossible to miss: the scooters. 🛵 #china #scooter #news

Think your city has traffic cameras? Beijing just added 1,500 this year. Our team explores the reality of a city where cameras track every move, from jaywalking to illegal parking. Join us as we take you inside more of China tonight at 6PM ET #camera #china #watch #specialreport #news
Fun fact: ping pong is China’s uncontested national sport! Join me tonight 6PM ET on @Fox News for more #behindthescenes here from Beijing 🇨🇳🏓🎥🎬 #specialreport #china #pingpong #behindthescenes
We went to a convenience store here in Beijing where we tested a humanoid robot worker #china #robot #ai
Long day here in Beijing, thank you all for tuning in for #specialreport and be sure to tune in again tomorrow for more #china #news #behindthescenes

Reporting live from Beijing as the Trump-Xi summit begins. Tonight we’re joined by a former senior PLA Colonel for a rare look inside the CCP’s strategy and what they hope to gain from this meeting. #specialreport
